name: GPU-based 3D Texture Advection with Logical-to-Physical Mapping
definition: A technique for visualizing unsteady 3D flow by advecting a property field ρ(x,t) along a vector field v(x,t) using a semi-Lagrangian approach, implemented on GPUs by mapping logical 3D grid memory to physical 2D texture memory to avoid slow 3D texture updates.
summary: This method visualizes unsteady 3D flow by mapping logical 3D grid memory to physical 2D texture memory, replacing expensive 3D texture operations with efficient 2D ones.
